en: Great dangers lie beyond those walls, $n. turn back until you are more seasoned in the ways of combat.
Think you can come here and steal from us, huh!?
With the Emperors slain, the magical protection blocking teleportation within the temple has been greatly weakened. If you desire, I am able to translocate you to the Emperors' lair.
I'll be fine for now, don't worry about me.  I'll find a way out of here once I've performed some cleansing rituals in this room.  Foul magic taints this place, $n.
Hopefully the reinforcements from Stormwind show up soon. . . .
Where is Un'Goro Crater?
It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.
Finally! I'll be glad to get out of this place.
Breathtaking. Children, when we return to the school, you will each give an oral report on one of these legendary people.
Very well. I will return then.

Sorry, but I am not disposed to sell horses to any individual who is not considered to be at least exalted to the Kingdom of Stormwind.  These steeds are the finest you'll find anywhere, and we certainly wouldn't want them in the hands of our enemies.$B$BNot saying you're an enemy, of course... just earn the trust of Stormwind and then we can do business.
Ahhh, you are looking for Dungar Longdrink. He has some of the fastest gryphons this side of Khaz Modan! You can find him up on the ramparts in the Trade District.

Unfortunately we do not have one who teaches Tailoring here in Bloodhoof Village, but you can find a trainer in Thunder Bluff.  Follow the path north out of the village until you come to a set of elevators.  Take one up to the top of the rise and ask one of the Bluffwatchers there for directions.
%s is VERY HUNGRY!
The curse ends!
Look for Faruza.  Last I saw she was standing out front between the stables and the house on the northwest end of town.
%s breaks free of its cocoon beneath Hive'Ashi.
The battlemaster
A $n attacks!

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of Orgrimmar.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from Orgrimmar for your duty and service.
Al'tabim, I seem to have misplaced my Zandalar Illusionist's Mantle. Can you supply me with a replacement?

$C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.

It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.
Take a look at this, Malyfous.

Look behind you, $r. The hive stirs as the land that surrounds us shudders and shakes.$B$BThe time has come for me to fulfill a promise I made a thousand years past. The sands shift once more as the Qiraji plan for war.
Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

Greetings, $r. The war materiel is gradually being sent on its way and should be at Cenarion Hold within $2113w day's time. We can only hope that once it is there that someone, having assembled the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, will step forward to ring the gong and open the gates.

Perhaps I can be of some assistance. I will make a deal with you, Satyr. I shall recover this unforged breastplate and slay the beast, Goraluk Anvilcrack. In exchange for this task, you will teach me how to create the breastplate.
Today you have unmade what took me years to create! For this you shall all die by my hand!

Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.
Return me to life.
Tirth's not himself these days, and neither is his assistant.
Our eye say you look lost.
Feel the power of the Brotherhood!
I want to create a guild crest.
The Alliance Flag was returned to its base by $n!
*sigh* ...113 degrees Kraklenheit. Can't you do any better?
